suggest.ext-fileinfo: Required by the MIME upload validator (ADI/Validators/MIME), which sniffs the uploaded bytes
suggest.ext-pcntl: Required by the Console platform on Linux (workers, forks and signals)
suggest.ext-posix: Required by the Console platform on Linux (process control and privileges)
suggest.ext-readline: Line editing, history and TAB completion in the servers' Interactive console
suggest.ext-sockets: Required by the UDP server (UDP_Server_CLI, exclusive port binding) and by the hot reload of the TCP and HTTP servers (listener handoff)
suggest.ext-sqlite3: Required by the SQLite database driver (ADI/Databases/SQL/Drivers/SQLite)
